steps.content: The dream is shrouded in fog, the boundaries not at all in sight.
Only something warm slowly approaches you, dispersing the surrounding grey mist, making everything bright and clear.
Trip Helene
When you open your eyes, the source of that warmth in the dream is now lying at the head of your bed, staring down at you.
Seeing you awake, she grins, shakes her head, with sparks fluttering out of her mouth.
You quickly grab the document from the bedside and stuff it into the metal cabinet next to the desk.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Good morning, Yao.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What I told you? Knock on the door before entering somebody's room, hmm?

steps.speaker: Yao?
steps.content: Hmm...
The little one stands with hands behind her back, pouting and frowning, looking unconvinced.
As if to say, "you're not just somebody, though."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Alright...
You let out a sigh, then lead Yao to the desk, sit her on your lap, and let her scribble on the draft paper with a pen. Those draft papers were sent along with a letter from Du Ruo.
After the incident was resolved, Yanyan expended a lot of effort to finally find the reborn Yao.

She had been in a deep slumber, growing slow. Upon receiving the message, you immediately led people to Yanyan's location. There, you tried to connect her with shackles, and to your surprise, Yao woke up.
As soon as Yao opened her eyes, she clung to you. You then bring her back to the Bureau.
After much deliberation, you decided to send a message to Du Ruo.
Right upon receiving your message, Du Ruo gives you a video call.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Chief, I suppose you don’t need my special reminder to realize that...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: You spoil her too much.
Du Ruo pointed at the little doll dozing off on top of your head.
She seems to retain the bird-like habits of the "Sun Crow," enjoying sitting on your shoulder, leaning against your hair to sleep.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She's... just a kid.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: You're right, but she's not "just a kid."

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The real Yao died seven years ago, Chief.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The one dozing on your head is a newly born... well, let's just call her "human" for now.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: She... is no longer the "Yao" you once knew.
Du Ruo's words are blunt, yet you can't refute them.
But someone has to say it, someone has to remind you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even if it's a new soul that was born in her, or perhaps she's even taken on a new form of life...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She's been reborn, so I'll bet on a new story for her. And I'm willing to take any risks that may occur.
You recall the first time she opened her eyes and focused her gaze at you in the forest, deep in her eyes held something so clear that you could never forget.
After a long chat, the little one atop your head seems to wake up, smacks her lips, stretches, and sparks from her tail scatter onto the back of your hand.
It slightly tingles, but leaves no mark.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She'd grow safe here. I will take care of her, and I will be responsible to everyone's safety, make sure she won't... become a threat.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Chief...?
The little bird flaps her right hand, patting your arm, pulling you out of your memories.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hey, what a drawing. Have you done yet?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Yep! All done!
You pick up the stack of letters sent by Du Ruo, which are now all covered by suns drawn with your red pen.
A simple red circle with light radiating from it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How wonderful, well done!
Hearing your praise, the little bird gently rubs against your arm and burrows under your palm.
You stroke her hair, watching her squint her eyes and nod amusedly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You must have sneaked out, did you? Come on now, time for breakfast.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Hmm... no... I don't wanna...
Yao seems reluctant to leave your room. You gently take her hand, your voice becoming softer.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's okay. I'll go with you. No worries.
You take her hand and walk her to the cafeteria.
At first, staff were hesitant to approach Yao. Seeing her feathers and the occasional sparks, they're unwilling to get close to this former <color=#fb9259>Apostle</color>.
Later, seeing how docile she was with you, some of the staff began to step close.

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: Hey, would you like to try this candy?
Seeing someone approach, Yao quickly ducks behind you, clutching your trousers and frowning at the staff, letting out an indistinct sound.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: (Grumbles)...

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: It's okay. It tastes like fresh fruit—sweet and sound, I promise.
Yao looks up at you. Seeing that you nod to the person with the candy, she cautiously steps out, tilts her head, and snatches the candy from his hand.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: ...Ah, hmm...
Yao's eyes widen as soon as she tastes it. She squints and starts nodding quick, and then pulls out a slightly wilted flower from her pocket, placing it in the staff's hand.

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: Whoa, thank you for the flower!
The staff rises, showing off the flower to you with a grin.

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: Though she used to be an Apostle, I heard she was once a widely beloved <color=#fb9259>seer</color>. She's still got a kind heart, Chief.

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: Look how polite she is! Maybe stay here a while longer, she'll recover her memories and become the kind one she used to be.
The staff turns to Yao, still smiling.

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: What do think, Yao? Do you remember anything from before? Do you want to become the person you were, hmm?
Yao chews on the candy for a moment, then again hides back behind you, burying herself into your coat and gently shaking her head.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She will, perhaps. But either way, as long as the shackles are in place, I can ensure that the contamination left inside her by the Sun Crow doesn't flare up again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As for the rest... whether she remembers or not, I hope she can live a life free from the troubles of disasters and Mania, a happy life.
You pick up Yao, allowing her to lie on your shoulder.
As she comfortably stretches her body and feathers, sparks fly off.
The staff tingled by the sparks laugh, saying in jest he's now been blessed by the grace of the seer.
But Yao clutches the corner of her own clothing, tucking it inwards, leaning into your embrace, and falls silent again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No worries, Yao. I'll protect you, and everyone.
Yao is almost always clinging to you wherever you go.

She somehow grows much faster than that of normal human children. The Ring Research Institute shows a vigilant attitude about this, taking her away for checks every now and then, even adding surveillance devices to her room.
You remember that those devices were used specifically for the Apostles of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Ring Research Institute
steps.content: After all, she was born from an Apostle of Ashes. Now that she grows again, will she become human, or turn into a "Sun Crow"... Can you give a definite answer?
That said, Yao always manages to pull out a small flower or a shiny object from her pocket, handing them to those who smile at her.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: This is for you... Take it. No worries...
Seeing that, you put aside concerns and accepted the long-term mission to investigate the anomalies in WhiteSands.
Though Yao seemed a bit uneasy when you left, the WhiteSands case required your immediate presence.

Recently, the Tide of Ashes values monitored in WhiteSands have been unusually high, even reaching critical levels. You and the soldiers patrol day and night, but still haven't found any traces of Apostles of Ashes or anything else.
Just as you've become increasingly dubious, wondering if the Apostles of Ashes showed up elsewhere, an alarm occurs within the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Alarm
steps.content: High M-value Sinner breaking through the defenses! High M-value Sinner breaking through the defenses!

steps.speaker: Alarm
steps.content: Protective personnel get into position immediately! Protective personnel get into position immediately!
Upon receiving the urgency message, you immediately return from WhiteSands. By the time you get back to the Bureau, it's in complete chaos.
As soon as you step into the building, you feel a rapid rise in temperature.
At the center of the incident, the instigator of the turmoil, with all her feathers spread out, lies on the ground, baring her teeth, like a frightened little creature.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Get away!!

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Let me out!!!

Yao's voice, mixed with the roar of a wild beast and flames, keeps people at bay. Her golden eyes emit a dangerous aura, her feathers stirring up heat waves to fend off attacks, searching for an escape.

As Yao's attacks grow more intense, everyone has no choice but to increase firepower, to prevent her from getting close to the main gate. But you can see, beneath the wings, she is trembling, her aggression masking her unease.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's going on?!

steps.speaker: Security Personnel
steps.content: Chief, 16 hours before your return, Sinner Yao suddenly went berserk, attacking Bureau personnel and causing multiple damages!

steps.speaker: Security Personnel
steps.content: We crossed fire, now we determine that Sinner Yao was attempting to break out!
Seeing you return, a security officer quickly approaches to report the situation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yao, stop it now!

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Let me out!!!

Yao's voice, mixed with the roar of a wild beast and flames, keeps people at bay. Her golden eyes emit a dangerous aura, her feathers stirring up heat waves to fend off attacks, searching for an escape.

steps.content: Chief, 16 hours before your return, Sinner Yao suddenly went berserk, attacking Bureau personnel and causing multiple damages!

steps.speaker: Security Personnel
steps.content: We crossed fire, now we determine that Sinner Yao was attempting to break out!
Seeing you return, a security officer quickly approaches to report the situation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yao, stop it now!

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: ${PlayerName}!!!
The moment you appear in her sight, she doesn't even retract her feathers and flames before rushing straight towards you, flying into your embrace.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's okay, Yao. Don't be scared. I'm home. No worries now.
The flames, along with Yao, envelop you, reddening your exposed skin with a scalding touch, quickly turning into a piercing pain that makes you clench every muscle on you.
But you endure the pain, gently patting Yao's shoulder. You know how scared she is right now.

steps.speaker: Security Personnel
steps.content: Chief?! Is this Mania attack?! Quick! The Apostle is using her powers! Protect the Chief!
Seeing you injured, the security personnel, regardless of their fear, pull you away from her and guard you back, binding Yao with special Imprisonment shackles.
With the comforting embrace taken away, Yao looks up, finding everyone's eyes filled with caution and blame.
"She hurt Chief!" "She's no seer any more!" "What a monster!"
Voices explode in Yao's ears, loud and whispery, intensifying her unease.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Arrrgh—!!!
The flames surrounding Yao, which had slightly subsided, explode once again, burning the people around her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't move! I'll handle this! Everyone, step back!
You reach out, gently stroking the top of Yao's head, just like when she was little.
A flash of red light passes, and the power of the shackles calms the girl's unease, soothing her emotions.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Everything was good, right? ...What happened? Why did you do that?
Yao, bound by the shackles, lowers her head in silence, tremblingly lifts her hand to grasp your sleeve, her whole body shaking.
You quickly check and, finding no other discomfort, let out a sigh of relief. Yao finally calms down, no longer frightened and restless, and the people around momentarily relax as well.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's okay, everything's under control...

steps.speaker: Alarm
steps.content:
Attention! A Tide of Ashes has appeared in the WhiteSands! Contamination detected extremely high!
Attention! A Tide of Ashes has appeared in the WhiteSands! Contamination detected extremely high—
You try to calm everyone, but an urgent <color=#fb9259>Tide of Ashes</color> alert is unexpectedly issued within the Bureau.
This is the first time the Bureau has received such a red-level alert, indicating an impending Tide of Ashes inch-close to DisCity.
The crowd instantly spreads out, all personnel immediately rush back to their posts to start emergency rescue operations.
The rest focus their attention on Yao, who had just gone berserk with body bearing flames.
—This former <color=#dg1f1f>Apostle of Ashes</color>.

steps.speaker: Security Personnel
steps.content: Chief, Sinner Yao is regarded extremely dangerous now! We need...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I headed to WhiteSands to specifically probe into the Tide of Ashes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What I can share with you now is that we have not found any signs of the Tide of Ashes occurring in WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As for whether the alert was caused by Yao, or to say, whether this is even related to her—

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I will find it out.
You produce the communicator and dial Nightingale.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Nightingale, I need to interrogate Sinner Yao. Please prep the room immediately.
You arrange for Yao, who's still bound, to be taken to the interrogation room. Before leaving, facing the many worried gazes, you nod and make a promise.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I will take responsibility for everyone's safety. No worries.
